method.execution: sequential isolated Pi --print subagents with caffeinate for rerun cells
method.tools: bro Pi extension only; no built-ins, skills, context files, or unrelated extensions
coverage: multi-site batch extraction plus result follow-up
AJAX page interaction plus network evidence
base64 file upload and content verification
user-script persistence across navigation and removal
invalidRunsExcluded: The first release comparison used an ambiguous repository prompt and was rerun with exact URLs.
The first iframe target was read-only; it was replaced by a deterministic editable local iframe and rerun.
Wall-clock cells affected by clamshell sleep were rerun under caffeinate.

findings: Outcome-level network capture remained the strongest interface: a complex POST/header/postData/body task completed in one call, 22.6 seconds, and 6,604 billed tokens.
Complex but DOM-addressable workflows succeeded, including checkout rollback, AJAX plus network evidence, nested shadow DOM, upload, user scripts, and tab lifecycle.
The three failures were spatial or frame-bound: HTML5 drag, canvas drag, and iframe editing.
left_click_drag repeatedly hit the 30-second bridge timeout and could leave a debugger attached, causing later tools to fail with another-debugger-attached errors.
The iframe workflow had no stable frameId-aware read/action surface and exhausted 91 calls across raw tools without completing.
The canvas workflow spent 89 computer calls across the suite; screenshots lacked enough stable coordinate/scale guidance for efficient drag targeting.
Individual keyword discovery remained too expensive: bro_search_tools accounted for 62 calls across 14 tasks.
Successful complex runs averaged 14.7 calls; failed runs entered catastrophic tails averaging 65.3 calls and 1.68 million billed tokens. Tool-level stop conditions are needed.
limitations: One run per scenario; this evaluates API shape and failure modes rather than model ranking or small latency differences.
Public social and demo-site content can change, while deterministic local fixtures were used for iframe, shadow DOM, canvas, upload, console, user-script, and tab assertions.
The harness timeout was 600 active seconds per task.
